1.title: Ward Churchill, Professor Who Challenged His Dismissal, Dies at 78
1.summary: His inflammatory essay about the Sept. 11 attacks prompted his dismissal by the University of Colorado for unrelated research misconduct. A jury later found that he had been wrongfully terminated for his views.

4.title: Live Updates: Europe Counts Down to a Total Solar Eclipse
4.summary: From Iceland to Spain, people have flocked to places where, briefly, the moon will completely block the sun. It is the continent’s first total eclipse in decades.

6.title: US inflation eases as food and fuel costs cool
